item.title: I was recognized as a "top reviewer" for NeurIPS 2026
item.description:
I did not submit a single paper to this year, and honestly I had no plans to attend. Then I (susprisingly) received an email informing me that, based on my performance as a reviewer, I have been granted a free registration!

This is a nice initiative, which both encourages and recognizes reviewers’ efforts, and I hope that more conferences will follow NeurIPS’ example. I will then be attending online.
